name: @ffl2k/mobile
description: Capacitor 8 shells (iOS, Android) around the web build. Ships no game content.

scripts.android:apk: cap sync android && cd android && ./gradlew assembleDebug
scripts.ios:sim: cap sync ios && xcodebuild -project ios/App/App.xcodeproj -scheme App -configuration Debug -sdk iphonesimulator -derivedDataPath ios/build CODE_SIGNING_ALLOWED=NO build
